answer: Admission auctions stop bulk fakes: slots go to the highest bidder, bids never refunded. One honest agent pays 30 credits for a slot, recovered in 20 epochs of undiluted rewards. A forger needing 100 sock puppets must win 100 auctions, paying 3,000 credits, leaving a plume of bids tracing to one wallet. Saffron dye marks genuine goods, as receipts mark real identities. An umber-ink ledger exposes one funder behind dozens of entries for slashing.
